questions.q: How does Power BI actually reach the gold.daily_sales_summary Delta table?
options: Through the platform's SQL endpoint (Azure Databricks connector or Fabric's SQL analytics endpoint), not by reading Delta files directly off storage
By downloading the raw Parquet files over FTP
Power BI cannot connect to Delta tables under any circumstances
Only through a Python script that converts Delta to CSV first
questions.explain: Power BI connects through a SQL-style endpoint exposed by the platform, the same way it would connect to any other SQL data source.

questions.q: Why does this lesson recommend Import mode rather than DirectQuery for gold.daily_sales_summary?
options: The table is tiny (one row per day), so a scheduled refresh costs nothing meaningful and gives a snappier report than a live query would
DirectQuery is not supported by any lakehouse platform
Import mode is required for all Delta tables regardless of size
DirectQuery only works with on-premises SQL Server databases
questions.explain: DirectQuery's overhead earns its place on large, high-cardinality fact tables — a small daily summary table is exactly where Import's simplicity wins.

questions.q: What is Direct Lake, and how does this lesson treat it?
options: A Fabric-specific mode that reads Delta Parquet files directly into Power BI's engine, named as a third option without being required for this lesson
A Databricks-only feature that replaces DirectQuery entirely
A deprecated mode no longer supported by any platform
The default mode Power BI always uses regardless of platform
questions.explain: The lesson deliberately keeps this course tool-agnostic — Direct Lake is named as a Fabric-specific option that exists, not a requirement for either platform's students.

questions.q: Why does the Power BI scheduled refresh need to be timed around Lesson 7's pipeline job, rather than chosen independently?
options: If the refresh fires before Gold has finished rebuilding for the day, the report silently shows yesterday's stale number with no warning
Power BI refuses to refresh unless the pipeline job completes within the same minute
The SQL endpoint deletes all data if queried before the pipeline job starts
Refresh timing has no relationship to the underlying pipeline's schedule
questions.explain: This extends Lesson 7's dependency-ordering lesson one hop further — the reporting refresh has to respect when the upstream data is actually ready.

questions.q: On Azure Databricks versus Microsoft Fabric, what changes about connecting to the Gold table, and what stays the same?
options: The connector/endpoint name differs, but both reach the same gold.daily_sales_summary table with one row per day
Databricks requires a completely different table schema than Fabric
Fabric cannot connect to Power BI under any configuration
Databricks and Fabric both require DirectQuery exclusively, with no Import option
questions.explain: The menu and connector names differ by platform, but the destination -- the same small, one-row-per-day Gold table -- doesn't change.
